name: MC Slicing
definition: A volume slicing technique that applies the pre-calculated table look-up idea from the Marching Cube algorithm to efficiently triangulate the intersection of a slicing plane with a hexahedron (volume), avoiding complex computational geometry algorithms.
summary: MC Slicing efficiently triangulates volume slices by using Marching Cubes' 256-case lookup table to determine intersected edges in linear time, reducing calculations compared to standard methods.
